title: Ootle Steam Kit
summary: Steam-linked Ootle integration kit with wallet, trading, games and prediction modules. November 5 public guide: Games, Trade and Predict are disabled before Steam sign-in. The site currently watches deliveries and settles holds itself; template-enforced trade escrow is a future destination. On Esmeralda, the site escrow signs the on-chain leg, with in-wallet signing described as planned for mainnet. Stealth hides amounts but not the account; voucher deposits and fees remain public. MIT source revision d54da665 remains unchanged and supports optional wallet-daemon integration and local ledger mode. The October 29 recording remains a Docs walkthrough of the settlement guide, not a completed trade or payment. No Steam login, wallet action or gameplay was performed. November 2 organizer notice records the Esmeralda reset; historical screenshots and footage retain their original dates.
cardSummary: Explore Steam-linked wallet, trading and game modules with private testnet payments and an operator-managed settlement flow.
creator: iGaming
